name: trishul
description: Predictive financial cyber-fraud intelligence and intervention platform

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @trishul/contracts && npm run build --workspace @trishul/database && npm run build --workspace @trishul/graph && npm run build --workspace @trishul/intelligence && npm run build --workspace @trishul/prediction && npm run build --workspace @trishul/trust && npm run build --workspace @trishul/audit
scripts.build:apps: npm run build --workspace @trishul/api && npm run build --workspace @trishul/worker && npm run build --workspace @trishul/psp-sandbox && npm run build --workspace @trishul/web
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build --workspace @trishul/database && npm run migrate --workspace @trishul/database
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
